result.strongest_objection: L6b's pack oracle spec contains a silent skip at the exact gate meant to prevent dev.23: 'Every DYNAMIC witness that exists on disk is in the zip.' If the lens bins are absent on disk when export-pack-check runs (lens-assets failed, ran out of order under make -j, or the target is invoked standalone before the fetch chain), the oracle passes with the bins unchecked and the pack ships without tables — precisely the failure V8 narrates ('there are no lens_*.bin entries... the bins were not on disk'). The doc's own verification log demonstrates this failure mode and then encodes it into the oracle as a silent conditional, violating the mission's no-silent-fallback axiom and the doc's own AC6 stance ('no silent skip'). A completeness oracle that treats 'cannot check' as 'pass' is not a completeness oracle.
result.catch: Three fixes/verifications: (1) Rewrite L6b assertion 2 so absent witnesses are loud: at publish-dev they must be a hard failure (V22 shows export-macos already runs lens-assets/starmap-assets/sky-bundle before it, so every witness should exist); standalone runs must print 'SKIP absent witness <path>' per missing witness and end the summary with an explicit skip count that publish-dev's grep requires to be 0 (e.g., STRICT=1 wiring). (2) M13 contradicts the stated mutation API: audit(include, exclude, literals) receives pre-extracted literals, but extraction with the real filters never scoped spike/*.gd, so mutating only the in-memory exclude list cannot bring res://data/raw/hip_v7.tsv into scope and M13 survives as specified — make audit() take (include, exclude) and perform the DirAccess walk and RegEx extraction internally per call, so the mutated exclude re-derives scope. (3) The load-bearing negative premise 'Nothing in make test relates the res:// paths to export_presets.cfg' has no V-row, unlike every positive premise; add a verification-log row (grep for export_presets/include_filter across Makefile, tests/, tools/) proving no existing audit is being duplicated. Also correct the citation slip: Makefile:366 (lens-assets dependency) is evidenced by V22, not V3.
result.proposed_fix: Replace L6b assertion 2 with: 'Every DYNAMIC witness is required on disk. In publish-dev wiring the target runs as export-pack-check-strict (STRICT=1): an absent witness is a hard failure named by path, since export-macos already fetches all staged artifacts (V22, Makefile:366). In plain make export-pack-check, each absent witness prints `SKIP absent witness <path>` and the summary becomes `export-pack-check: <n> checked, <s> skips, 0 failures`; the publish-dev grep requires `, 0 skips,`. Update AC8 to assert both green and `grep -c "SKIP absent witness" = 0` under publish-dev.' Change the L6a step-8 signature to `audit(include: PackedStringArray, exclude: PackedStringArray) -> Array[String]` with scope-walk and extraction performed inside audit() per call, so M13's mutated exclude re-derives scope; note that test_export_audit.gd passes raw filter arrays only. Add V24: `grep -rn "export_presets\|include_filter" Makefile tests/ tools/ | grep -vc export_audit` returning no pre-existing audit target, substantiating the 'missing static half' claim. Fix the L6b text citation from 'V3/Makefile:366' to 'V22/Makefile:366'.

result.strongest_objection: The design claims the captain PNGs are 'checked by L6b's witness-presence assertion', which is impossible under the document's own rules. L6b only checks literals classified R/F and DYNAMIC witnesses. The PNGs are not literals, and they cannot be DYNAMIC witnesses because the `assets/characters/captain` row uses filter `""`, which explicitly mandates that 'all its witnesses must pass R'. Since PNGs are not in `AUTO_EXT`, they fail rule R, cannot be listed as witnesses, and are therefore entirely unchecked by L6b.
result.catch: False claim of oracle test coverage for unmeasured PNG resources.
result.proposed_fix: Update the 'assets/characters/captain' analysis and the Risks/Mitigations section to explicitly state that the raw PNGs are completely unverified statically and by the oracle, and that their presence is safeguarded solely by the runtime exported-app smokes. Remove the false claim that L6b checks them.

result.strongest_objection: Rule 3 extracts literals with the single regex `res://[^"]*`, which can only see double-quoted strings, and no verification row establishes that shipped code contains no single-quoted `res://` literals — V6/V7 measured the corpus with the same double-quote grep, so the premise is self-confirming, not verified. A path read as `'res://data/foo.bin'` would be never extracted, never classified, and the audit stays green while the export drops the file: a silent false-green channel in Goal 1's core guarantee ('fails when shipped code reads a path that export_presets.cfg would drop'), i.e. the exact dev.23 failure class this doc exists to kill. The risk table names the no-prefix blind spot but not the quote-style blind spot.
result.catch: Two concrete secondary defects to verify or fix: (1) M13's named killing assertion contradicts rule 4 — `res://data/raw/hip_v7.tsv` has an extension, so it is class F and fails as 'not covered', not UNCLASSIFIED (UNCLASSIFIED requires no/ambiguous form class per rule 4's preamble), yet AC3 demands each mutant be killed 'by its named assertion'. (2) AC3/AC4/AC6/AC7 hardcode `.godot/tmp/...` log and zip paths, while the Makefile snippet writes to `$(SCRATCH)/...`; no V row verifies `SCRATCH := .godot/tmp`, so four acceptance criteria may reference a path the target never writes.
result.proposed_fix: 1) Add V24: `git grep -nE "'res://" -- '*.gd' | grep -vE '^(tests|tools|spike)/'` with observed output (expected empty); if non-empty, fold the hits into the 90 measured literals and update V6/V7. 2) Amend rule 3 to run both `res://[^"]*` and `res://[^']*` over each scoped file and union the (literal, file:line) pairs, so any future single-quoted literal is extracted rather than silently skipped. 3) Correct M13's killing assertion to `F res://data/raw/hip_v7.tsv not covered` (per rule 4, a `.tsv` literal is class F), or move the tsv case under an explicit no-extension UNCLASSIFIED example if that was the intent. 4) Add V25: `grep -n '^SCRATCH' Makefile` recording the existing definition (expected `SCRATCH := .godot/tmp`), and rewrite AC3/AC4/AC6/AC7 to use `$(SCRATCH)` (or the verified literal path) so every acceptance command targets the file the target actually writes.
